title: Desktop Cable Pass-Through Grommets — What grommets do
description: Desktop cable grommets are rings that line a hole cut through the desk, letting cables pass from top to underside cleanly. They turn cable spaghetti into a disappearing act: up from the PC, down through the desk, gone.

title: Desktop Cable Pass-Through Grommets — Fill math
